name: hmd-ms-deployment
description: Deployment orchestration microservice — resolves resource-based cross-repo dependencies and drives Argo-based deployment across environments.

discovery.summary: Deployment orchestration microservice for the NeuronSphere platform. Owns the metadata graph of RepoClasses, RepoClassVersions, and RepoInstances, and drives the Argo-based deployment DAG that applies ChangeSets across Environments (dev/test/prod). Maintains the namespaced, versioned Resource Definition catalog (NERD0004): repos declare what they produce/consume as typed resources instead of pinning a specific dependency repo, resolution supports type inheritance and tag-selector matching, and a definition-driven dev-config resolver generates local hmd deploy --local configs for repos that aren't yet persisted RepoInstances.

entry_points.description: Registered service operations — the microservice's public REST API surface (40+ /apiop/* endpoints).
Deployment DAG construction and dependency-satisfaction logic.
Resource Definition catalog and resource-based dependency resolution (NERD0004).
Start here for how to use the deployment service end to end.

capabilities.name: POST /apiop/apply_changeset
capabilities.description: Applies a ChangeSet to a DeploymentSet, creating ChangeSetDeployment/ChangeSetEnvDeployment records and triggering the Argo workflow.

capabilities.name: POST /apiop/deploy_change_set_deployment/<args_id>
capabilities.description: Executes the deployment workflow for a ChangeSetDeployment via Argo.

capabilities.name: POST /apiop/destroy_deploymentset
capabilities.description: Destroys instances in a deployment set, in reverse dependency order.

capabilities.name: GET /apiop/get_deployment_bom/<args_type>
capabilities.description: Returns the deployment Bill of Materials for an environment.

capabilities.name: POST /apiop/resync_repo_class_version_dependencies
capabilities.description: Repairs an existing RepoClassVersion's dependency edges from its current manifest, without registering a new version — prevents silent truncation of dependency roles.

capabilities.name: POST /apiop/seed_base_resource_definitions
capabilities.description: Idempotently seeds the standard base ResourceDefinition catalog (NERD0004) on service startup.

capabilities.name: GET /apiop/suggest_resource_dependencies/<args_type>
capabilities.description: Suggests RepoInstances that could satisfy a resource-type dependency in an environment (NERD0004 SPEC0008).

capabilities.name: POST /apiop/generate_dev_deployment_config
capabilities.description: Resolves a local dev --config-file from a repo's manifest deploy block, definition-driven (NERD0004 SPEC0008), for repos not yet a persisted RepoInstance.

capabilities.name: validate_dependencies_satisfied
capabilities.description: Checks whether a RepoInstance's declared dependencies (name- or resource-based) are satisfied before allowing deployment.

capabilities.name: build_deployment_dag
capabilities.description: Constructs the topologically-sorted deployment DAG for a ChangeSet.

capabilities.name: ResourceInformation
capabilities.description: Resource/ResourceDefinition query and matching logic, including inheritance- and tag-aware dependency satisfaction.
